description: Checks that the Reclaim attestor works from this machine by proving a public CoinGecko price request with a throwaway key. It uses no credential, provider, or logged-in site, and takes up to 45 seconds (about 8 when healthy). Call it once when you set up a new provider build, and after `run_proof` fails with a network error. Returns `{ ok, attestorUrl, durationMs, extractedParameters, error, errorKind, proofFiles }`. `proofFiles` is the proof file download state: `{ status }` is `idle`, `ready`, `downloading` (with `method`, `elapsedMs`, and `bytesDownloaded`/`totalBytes` when known), or `failed` (with `reason`). If `ok` is true, the attestor is fine and a failing proof points to the target site. If `errorKind` is `proof-files-downloading`, the one-time proof file download is still running and the attestor was not contacted: call this tool again shortly; do not report a network problem. If it is `proof-files-failed`, the download failed: tell the developer `error` (usually no access to github.com or raw.githubusercontent.com). If it is `attestor-unreachable`, the proof files are ready but this machine cannot reach the attestor (network, VPN, firewall, or proxy): tell the developer. If it is `setup-failed`, other local setup failed: report `error`. If it is `attestor-error`, the attestor rejected the claim: report `error`.

attestorUrl.description: Attestor websocket URL. Set it only if the developer supplied one; the default is the public attestor.

name: check_attestor
